parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning. You've reached Sumerton Child Care Center. This is Sarah speaking. How can I assist you today?

Hi, Sarah. I'm planning to visit your center with my children next weekend, and I'd like to get some information about your facilities and activities.

Of course, I'd be happy to help. First, let me give you our location. We're on North Hill, right opposite the supermarket. Oh, wait. Sorry about that. That's our old location. We're now opposite the toy factory, just down the road.

Got it. Is parking available there?

Absolutely. There's plenty of parking available, both in front of the center and in the overflow lot around the corner. You'll find it much easier than the old location, which had limited space.

That's a relief. What about entry fees?

Entry is actually free for everyone, and to make it even better, adults receive a complimentary drink. Some people think it's only coffee, but we offer tea, water, and even juice as options.

That's generous. Are there any new features or attractions at your center?

Oh, yes. We've added a lot recently. There's a large slide, which we call the Wildcat. It's quite popular. It's bigger and steeper than our older slides, so it's a real hit. Then, we've introduced a mini-golf area for children, complete with five themed courses.

Wow, that sounds amazing. Are there any other play areas?

Well, we still have the jungle gym and the arts and crafts corner, but those aren't new. There's also a sand pit, but it's currently under renovation. The slide and the golf courses are the main attractions we're highlighting this year.

Great. Are there any special requirements for kids who want to participate?

Yes, there are a few. First, all children must wear trousers. This is mainly for safety during activities like sliding or climbing. Shorts just aren't suitable.

Okay, that’s good to know.

Oh, and every child must also wear socks. This is particularly important for the indoor play zones, as we don’t allow barefoot play for hygiene reasons.

Got it. Anything else we need to prepare?

Yes. You’ll need to bring a label with each child’s name on it. We can provide labels at the center if you forget, but it’s easier if you come prepared.

Sure, I can manage that. By the way, I’m also thinking of organizing a birthday party for my son. Do you have any packages for that?

Absolutely. Our birthday party packages are very popular. To book a party, you’ll need at least eight children. That’s the minimum number of participants.

And what’s included in the package?

The basic package includes food, drinks, and decorations. You can also add optional extras like a cake or entertainment, say a magician or a clown for an additional fee.

That sounds nice. Do you cater for dietary restrictions?

Yes, we do. We have vegetarian and gluten-free options, and we can customize the menu further if needed. Just let us know in advance so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Perfect. Are there any discounts if we book early?

Actually, yes. If you book at least two weeks in advance, you’ll get a 10% discount on the total package price. That applies to all parties booked for weekends.

That’s fantastic. Thanks so much for the detailed information.

You’re welcome. Feel free to call back if you have any more questions or you can visit our website for more details.

Will do. Thanks again.

analyses.content: Sarah 纠正说超市是旧地址，现在的地址是在 toy factory（玩具工厂） 对面。
We're on North Hill, right opposite the supermarket. Oh, wait. Sorry about that. That's our old location. We're now opposite the toy factory, just down the road.
听到 "Sorry about that" 后要立刻警觉，因为这意味着前面的 "supermarket" 是错误信息，答案在后面的修正里。
Got it. Is parking available there? Absolutely. There's plenty of parking available, both in front of the center and in the overflow lot around the corner.
题目中的 "A lot of areas" 对应原文的 "plenty of... available"，要抓取核心名词 Parking。
录音中提到中心门前和拐角处都有大量的 Parking（停车位） 可用。
Entry is actually free for everyone, and to make it even better, adults receive a complimentary drink. Some people think it's only coffee, but we offer tea, water, and even juice as options.
不要填 coffee 或 tea，原文说有人以为只有咖啡，但实际上提供多种选择，统称为 drink。
入场免费，且为了让体验更好，成年人可以得到一杯免费的 drink（饮料）。
Oh, yes. We've added a lot recently. There's a large slide, which we call the Wildcat. It's quite popular.
题目结构是 "... for the Wildcat"，Wildcat 是名字，你需要填的是这个物体的本体 slide。
Sarah 介绍新设施里有一个很大的 slide（滑梯），名字叫 Wildcat。
录音中提到为孩子们新引入了带有五个主题路线的 mini golf（迷你高尔夫）场地。
你需要听到 "courses" 前面的具体游乐项目，直接填入 golf 或 mini golf 均可，不要忽略了整体语义。
Then we've introduced a mini golf area for children, complete with five themed courses.
为了安全，所有参加活动的孩子必须穿 trousers（长裤）。
First, all children must wear trousers. This is mainly for safety during activities like sliding or climbing. Shorts just aren't suitable.
原文明确排除了 "shorts"（短裤），注意 trousers 是复数形式。
Oh, and every child must also wear socks. This is particularly important for the indoor play zones, as we don’t allow barefoot play for hygiene reasons.
题目词组是 "Wear a pair of..."，后面通常接复数名词，别忘了加 's'。
为了卫生，在室内游戏区每个孩子都必须穿 socks（袜子）。
Yes. You’ll need to bring a label with each child’s name on it. We can provide labels at the center if you forget, but it’s easier if you come prepared.
题目是 "label for their..."，对应原文 "label with each child's name"，核心词是 name。
你需要带一个标签，上面写着每个孩子的 name（名字）。
To book a party, you’ll need at least eight children. That’s the minimum number of participants.
题目中的 "Minimum number" 对应原文的 "at least"，听到这个信号词后的数字就是答案。
预订生日派对至少需要 8 个孩子参加。
The basic package includes food, drinks, and decorations. You can also add optional extras like a cake or entertainment...
小心后面的 cake 和 magician，那些是需要额外付费（additional fee）的可选项，不是基本套餐包含的。
基本套餐包含食物、饮料和 decorations（装饰品）。
